summary: Iteration 3 validated all NEW additions: delivery endpoints (create/list/status/tracking), ride tracking endpoint, updated fare rates for Ride (20+7,30+10,50+13) and Delivery (25+8,40+11,60+14), admin stats deliveries_count + delivery revenue, and UI removals (flowchart, India's on-time promise, demo login buttons). Real login for all three seed accounts (user/driver/admin) works and /login URL is synced. Delivery flow booking end-to-end verified in browser. Backend pytest: 9/9 pass after two minor fixes made by testing agent.

minor.issue: Fixed by testing agent: (a) endpoint returned 500 (Mongo _id leaked into response causing 'ObjectId not iterable') — now excludes _id; (b) UserSignup Pydantic role validator only allowed 'user'|'driver' so admin signup returned 422 instead of the intended 403 — validator widened to include admin so explicit 403 raise fires.

action_items: None blocking. Main agent may optionally consolidate signup role validation into a single place (validator OR handler check, not both).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py signup returned raw user_doc after insert_one, which Motor mutates to include Mongo _id — root-cause of 500. Testing agent added _id exclusion to the response projection.
UserSignup.validate_role rejected 'admin' at validation layer, making the in-handler admin-403 branch (line 205-206) dead code. Widened validator so intended 403 path is reachable.
server.py is 731 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routes/models modules.
PUT /api/deliveries/{id}/tracking and /rides/{id}/tracking correctly restrict to assigned captain and to active statuses. Good.
Admin stats now aggregates deliveries_count and delivery revenue into total_revenue as required.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py (rewrote for new fare rates, added delivery + tracking + admin coverage; uses a dynamic 2nd driver signup instead of hard-coded seed driver to avoid rider==driver conflicts)
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — Rider user@ops.com/user123, Captain driver@ops.com/driver123, Admin admin@ops.com/admin123. All login OK.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one throwaway TEST_driver2-<uuid> account via public signup so lifecycle tests can accept rides/deliveries created by user@ops.com without hitting the 'rider cannot be their own driver' rule.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py now covers auth, ride fare/lifecycle/tracking, delivery fare/lifecycle/tracking, admin stats. Rerun with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py -v. Fare formulas locked: Ride Bike=20+7/km, Auto=30+10/km, Car=50+13/km; Delivery Bike=25+8/km, Auto=40+11/km, Car=60+14/km. UI removed flowchart, India promise, demo buttons; tagline is 'On Time Providing Services'. Delivery UI booking works and displays correct rounded ₹ fare.
rca of the issue: 1) Signup 500: Motor's insert_one adds Mongo _id (ObjectId) to the passed dict; response then failed JSON serialization at fastapi.encoders since ObjectId isn't iterable. Fix: strip _id in the returned projection like all other endpoints already do. 2) Signup admin 422 vs 403: Pydantic field_validator ran first and raised 422 before handler logic could raise 403. Fix: validator now allows the value so the handler's explicit 403 branch is exercised.
